target: Player 90th percentile of route 95th-percentile speeds, on rookie REG non-nullified charted routes from one second after snap through pass release; >=30 routes/player
scouting_inputs: Only provided pre-draft conventional/NGS and Combine tracking; no NFL state, team, route mix, draft pick or route count predictor
limitation: Capacity proxy depends on observed route opportunities and participating rookies; not separation, production, injury, draft-bust risk or a pure maximal physiological speed.
